explanation.headline: Oseltamivir phosphate is not on FDA's shortage list as of 2026-10-21; three hospital sites hold 14.6 to 21.3 days on hand

sentences.text: FDA's drug shortage list does not include oseltamivir phosphate as of 2026-10-21.
Corvale East holds 233 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 13.7 per day for 17.1 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 297 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 16.3 per day for 18.2 days on hand.
Corvale Lakeside holds 47 capsules of the 75 mg presentation at 3.2 per day for 14.6 days on hand.
Corvale East holds 331 capsules of the 45 mg presentation at 15.7 per day for 21.1 days on hand.
Corvale General holds 341 capsules of the 45 mg presentation at 16 per day for 21.3 days on hand.
The rule‑based best option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose label names no plant we could place.
